trace.supplyTargetNote: Provisional starter supply, not final yield: several ingots-equivalent of Iron and Copper over reasonable surface/cave exploration. These rates propose 2.8 trace blocks/chunk on average before stone/surface clipping, about 0.84 each Iron/Copper and 1.12 Coal. Verify actual recovery after low-yield processing values are assigned; do not count each rock as an ingot.

economy.unfinalizedYieldNote: Targets are planning metadata, not block drops or recipes. Iron may exceed 10000. Osmium must support Mekanism; iridium may yield only tens over very large-scale processing. Low-yield/rich-rock recoverable mB and recovery efficiencies remain unassigned.
economy.note: Potential material content only; no processing, casting, tool or recovery recipes are defined here.

provisional.implementationGeometry: Terrain height thresholds, exterior cover, cave search range, rich cluster sizes, indicator rates and 50000-block safety ceiling are provisional implementation controls; no mineral or recipe changes.
provisional.regionSize: 512-block deterministic candidate cells; implementation tuning, not approved deposit spacing.
provisional.majorAttemptChance: 0.65 before deterministic spacing rejection; provisional, not actual accepted-deposit density.
provisional.depth: -60..64 center bounds and 42/0/-44 interpolation anchors operationalize the approved conceptual shallow/mid/deep bands.
provisional.baseWeights: Every deposit baseWeight is provisional; approved biome/depth weights are copied exactly.
provisional.micro: All occurrence chances and jackpot chances are provisional; approved eligibility and maximum sizes are retained.
provisional.trace: All numeric trace occurrence rates and patch sizes are provisional and require early-development playtesting.
provisional.placer: All numeric placer occurrence rates, bank distance and counts are provisional.
provisional.economy: Only 1000 mB per ingot and 9000 mB per storage block are final; all other mB values are approximate approved concepts, not recipes.
provisional.associated: Cobalt poor/normal occurrence chances, Thorium's Uranium quantity, ordinary associated cluster sizes and diamond jackpot chance are provisional.
